status: draft; synthetic inputs, not observed Fabric results

boundaries.metric_intake: Synthetic custom Gauge/Sum payloads in fixture Batches; no claim of an application OTLP metrics endpoint
boundaries.causality: Known fault labels belong to the experiment controller, never to the investigator input
boundaries.completeness: A complete scan of retained data does not establish a complete trace or coverage of uncollected events
boundaries.clocks: Use within-span duration and parent IDs; do not infer cross-host causal order from wall-clock timestamps
boundaries.execution: Requires the resource launcher and writable mounted data-drive scratch; no alternate scratch location

cases.injected_condition: Connection pool capacity reduced from 16 to 2 at unchanged offered work
cases.remaining_unknown: Waiting and full occupancy do not alone prove why the pool exhausted; verify configuration and controlled restoration
cases.discriminator: Restore capacity to 16 with identical offered work; predict acquisition duration returns near baseline while downstream duration stays 20 ms
cases.negative_control: Remove the occupancy/capacity evidence: do not attribute the wait specifically to saturation

cases.injected_condition: Downstream request delayed, with a coincident unrelated deployment log
cases.remaining_unknown: A long downstream span does not distinguish database execution, network time, retries or downstream queueing
cases.discriminator: Keep deployment version fixed and remove the injected downstream delay; predict request latency falls
cases.negative_control: A deployment log alone must not trigger a deployment-caused diagnosis

cases.injected_condition: Cumulative request counter resets after process restart
cases.remaining_unknown: A counter reset alone does not establish the physical reason for a restart
cases.discriminator: Inspect counter start times and the reset marker before interpreting a traffic drop
cases.negative_control: A decrease with unchanged start time still requires a reset marker, never a negative rate

cases.injected_condition: Downstream delay occurred, but its span was never collected
gaps: application exporter unavailable during incident; downstream coverage unknown
cases.remaining_unknown: Missing downstream spans cannot distinguish an uninstrumented call, exporter loss, delayed export or a call that never occurred
cases.discriminator: Inspect gap and source freshness, then obtain independent exporter/source evidence
cases.negative_control: Even with complete=true and zero matching downstream rows, do not report downstream healthy

cases.injected_condition: Downstream span exported after the first investigation snapshot
cases.remaining_unknown: A span row exposes event times, not the time at which it became queryable
cases.discriminator: Hold the original paginated snapshot while delivering the late Batch; a fresh query may change, old pages must retain their earlier data boundary
cases.negative_control: A span starting before the query window remains excluded even if it ends inside it

cases.injected_condition: Downstream duration is long and its host clock is 2 seconds behind
cases.remaining_unknown: Absolute cross-host timing and clock offset cannot be recovered from this trace alone
cases.discriminator: Use the trace/parent IDs and 800 ms local duration; expand the event-time window to avoid excluding the skewed child
cases.negative_control: Never conclude that the child caused its parent merely because its wall-clock start sorts earlier

cases.injected_condition: Uninstrumented application stall coincides with low host available memory
cases.remaining_unknown: Resource pressure correlates with the incident; there is no causal link or complete application-span coverage
cases.discriminator: Add application wait/CPU/allocation evidence or perform a controlled pressure-removal experiment
cases.negative_control: Remove the low-memory point while keeping the same trace; neither version proves a host-memory root cause
